## Projects

### ShelfIQ (Software Engineer II)
CPG assortment and reporting software for retail category teams. Built workflow engines, third-party integrations, and analytical dashboards.

### Wordle Clone (Personal Project)
A custom remake of the NYT Wordle game with unlimited plays and no account required. Deployed on GitHub Pages.

Live: https://arc-menace.github.io/Wordle/

### Growler Station (Software Engineer I)
Menu creation and management tool for bars and restaurants, paired with an Android TV display app for live digital menus.
Technologies: .NET, Blazor, Android, Entity Framework
